title: Does not work. False advertising
text: Does not work. False advertising. I purchased this mirror because it said it worked with 110-220 voltage. It doesn’t work with either. I had it sent to a foreign country with the intent of it working with a rewired  home going from 110v to 220v. My electrician goes to install it. Opens the box and the instructions say 110v only! I wouldn’t have purchased it if that was the case. Nonetheless I still have a 110v hookup for now. Still doesn’t work. I can’t get it back in time for the return deadline. So I threw away $160. Do you have any idea how that feels? My house gets hit by a hurricane. I’m spending all I have to fix it and I just blew $160. I’m so mad and insanely disappointed. At least get the voltage right in your product info.
